findings.headline: Rename this tabIndex attribute to tabindex.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.0-rc.21's JSX types declare tabindex on this intrinsic element and no longer declare the camelCase tabIndex alias that Solid 1.9.13's types accepted, so tsc rejects the attribute key at this site.
findings.guidance: Rename tabIndex to tabindex on this element. Keep the attribute value byte-identical: the runtime attribute name is the same HTML attribute, only the TypeScript property key changed. Stop and ask when the value expression was computed from a type that depended on the camelCase key (for example a mapped type keyed by this attribute name).
